Does not follow links from an X-Robots-Tag nofollow page when robots directives are respected

```typescript title="TypeScript"
import { crawl, createEngine } from "@xberg-io/crawlberg";
async function main() {
  const engineConfig = { maxDepth: 1, respectRobotsTxt: true };
  const engine = createEngine(engineConfig);
  const url = "https://example.com";
  const result = await crawl(engine, url);
  console.log(result.pages?.length);
  console.log(result.pages?.[0]?.nofollowDetected);
  console.log(result.pages?.[0]?.noindexDetected);
}

void main();
```
